_comment: The narrator voice used for module videos. To change voice, ask Claude to list voices (ElevenLabs connector, creative_list_voices), pick one, and update voice_id, name and model_id here. Keep notes honest about what the connector cannot set.
name: Lee (Narration) Middle-Aged Australian Male
notes: Lee chosen on 13 Oct 2026 to replace Roger. On 14 Oct 2026 the user compared three takes and chose eleven_v4 with a conversational rewrite of the script (short sentences, contractions, questions such as 'No auto-injector?'), starting the prompt with the [calmly] audio tag. The connector cannot set stability, similarity or speed on any model. v4 pauses at commas almost as long as at full stops, so expect to set most sentence boundaries in overrides.json from the chunk listing. Anaphylaxis, stroke, hypoglycaemia, chest pain, sepsis, falls, pain management, ACPO, headache and nausea and vomiting (16 Oct 2026; the first pain take garbled its last 15 seconds, so check loudness over time and the closing words of every take) are all narrated this way (re-narrated 14 Oct 2026; sepsis 14 Oct 2026, re-narrated the same day). The lead instructor wants ceftriaxone and cephalosporin said with a hard K: spell them "keftriaxone" and "kefalosporins" in the text sent to the voice; envenomation uses the user's own YouTube videos. Roger (voice_id CwhRBWXzGAHq8TQ4Fs17, eleven_multilingual_v2) is no longer used. Cloned voices were refused on the user's plan earlier, so test any new voice with one short line first. TBI (paramedic, 16 Oct 2026): the full 3:13 take developed rising background hiss from about 1:50, and a 74 s re-take of the last four scenes went loud and distorted after 60 s; a 14 s take of the final lines was clean. The narration is three takes joined at pauses (see tbi/video-src/overrides.json). For long scripts, consider two or three shorter takes from the start and check the noise floor (quietest 0.1 s per 10 s) of every take. Crush syndrome (paramedic, 19 Oct 2026): at the owner's request, narrated by Lee on eleven_v3 instead of v4 as a trial (v4 felt slower). One 2:24 take, 291 words (about 121 words a minute), clean noise floor throughout; v3 also pauses at commas, so every sentence end is set in crush/video-src/overrides.json. model_id above stays eleven_v4 until the owner decides.
